人類を救う“希望”<br>って言われるほどのお方:
The one they call the 'Hope' to save
humanity
いったいどんな人なんだろう？: I wonder what kind of person they are?
頭は切れるが、ひねくれ者<br>ってお話でしたけどぉ……:
I've heard he's sharp, but
a bit eccentric...
お前か？<br>三大国からの使者ってのは:
Is that you?
The envoy from the three great nations?
先に言っとくが、<br>俺は引き受けないぞ？:
Just so you know—
I'm not taking this, okay?
ええっ！？<br>まだ何も言って……:
W-What!?
I haven't even said anything yet...
言わなくても察しはつくさ。<br>どうせ厄介事だろ？:
You don't have to say it—I can tell.
It's bound to be some kind of trouble, right?
こんな辺境の地までわざわざ<br>厄介者の俺に会いに来るんだ:
You actually came all the way out to this backwater
just to see a troublesome person like me?
厄介事の依頼しか<br>考えられないだろ？:
It can only be a request to deal
with some troublesome matter, right?
数か月前の謎の大穴の出現、<br>そして巨大な化け物の襲撃……:
The mysterious giant pit that appeared a few months ago,
and then the attack by that huge monster...
大穴周辺の小国が一晩で<br>地図から消えたと噂に聞く……:
I've heard rumors that the small nations around the pit
vanished from the map overnight...
三大国の戦力を集結させ<br>巨大な怪物はなんとか退けました:
The three great nations mustered their forces
and somehow drove the giant monster back.
単刀直入に申し上げますっ！: I'll get straight to the point!
前線基地の”司令官”に<br>着任いただきたいのですっ！:
We want you to take up the post of the "commander"
of the front-line base!
三大国が共同出資し、突貫工事で<br>建設中って噂の基地か……:
So it's that base rumored to be jointly funded by the three great nations
and being rushed into construction...
最初に言っただろ？<br>他を当たってくれ……:
Didn't I say so at the start?
Go ask someone else...
ほら、立てるか？<br>しっかし、豪快にすっ転んだなぁ～:
Here, can you get up?
Man, you really took a spectacular spill.
あなたが司令官になってくれるまで<br>この手は離しませんっ！:
I won't let go until you
become the commander!
だって……もし引き受けなかったら<br>あなたは……！:
Because... if you don't accept it,
you'll—!
あなたは三大国から追われ、<br>投獄されてしまいますっ！:
You'll be hunted by the three great
nations and thrown into prison!
も、もしかしたら、<br>お命もどうなるか……:
I-I...
your life might even be in danger...
なるほどな。最初から俺に<br>拒否権なんてなかったわけだ……:
I see.
So I never really had the right to refuse from the start...
引き受けてやるよ、<br>その化け物退治を……:
Alright.
I'll take it—I'll deal with that monster...
